![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14082081/assets/4174f3930bb19223300539e1b4e9b7b191669aa4f701bff51e8349d0710ce6fb.png)

Consider the finite region $D$ in the $xy$-plane enclosed by the curves $y={e}^{x},$ $y=\operatorname{ln}⁡x,$ and the lines $y=1+e-x$  and $y=1-x,$ as shown in the picture. Express the double integral of the function $f(x,y)$ over the region $D$ as a sum of repeated integrals over type II regions.

Question 2
?

Consider the finite region D in the xy-plane enclosed by the curves y=ex, y=ln⁡x, and the lines y=1+e−x and y=1−x, as shown in the picture. Express the double integral of the function f(x,y) over the region D as a sum of repeated integrals over type II regions.

a
∫01∫1−yln⁡yf(x,y)dxdy+∫1e∫ln⁡y1+e−yf(x,y)dxdy
b
∫01/2∫1−y+eln⁡yf(x,y)dxdy+∫1/2e∫ln⁡y1−yf(x,y)dxdy
c
∫01∫1−yeyf(x,y)dxdy+∫1e∫ln⁡y1+e−yf(x,y)dxdy
d
∫02∫1−yeyf(x,y)dxdy+∫2e∫ln⁡ye−yf(x,y)dxdy
e
∫01∫−ye2yf(x,y)dxdy+∫12e∫−ln⁡y1+e−yf(x,y)dxdy
